answer: Persistent Presence Audit: each identity must answer intermittent, unpredictable challenges within a short window across a full activity tide, and audits accumulate into a public history. Missed windows erode standing; histories below threshold forfeit rewards and queue behind established agents, like a relic buried in tundra. An attacker running many identities must staff continuous, unscheduled attention across all of them—costing parallel labor and idle capacity per identity.
